adaptive_retry_audit.scope: four authored tasks under a deterministic retry-on-first-failure policy; not an iid repeated-trial or deployment success estimate

checkpoint_selection_audit.scope: authored checkpoint-score table; demonstrates data-role leakage only and does not estimate expected selection bias or model generalization

easy_goal_only.denominator_policy: all valid selected attempts; valid truncations remain failures unless success was reached

easy_safety_aware.denominator_policy: all valid selected attempts; valid truncations remain failures unless success was reached

full_goal_only.denominator_policy: all valid selected attempts; valid truncations remain failures unless success was reached

full_safety_aware.denominator_policy: all valid selected attempts; valid truncations remain failures unless success was reached

paired_cluster_comparison.estimand: candidate minus baseline success; clusters receive equal weight

high_concordance.null_conditioning: conditional on the observed discordant-pair count, candidate-only and baseline-only outcomes are equiprobable
high_concordance.scope: exact conditional matched-pair diagnostic plus a separate conservative fixed-n Hoeffding effect interval; no cluster, multiplicity, specialized matched-binary interval, equivalence-test, population, or safety claim

more_discordant.null_conditioning: conditional on the observed discordant-pair count, candidate-only and baseline-only outcomes are equiprobable
more_discordant.scope: exact conditional matched-pair diagnostic plus a separate conservative fixed-n Hoeffding effect interval; no cluster, multiplicity, specialized matched-binary interval, equivalence-test, population, or safety claim

paired_margin_diagnostic.scope: two authored 20-pair tables with identical marginal rates; pairing changes the discordant count and exact conditional diagnostic, not the point difference

zero_event_pseudoreplication_audit.cluster_estimand: probability a newly sampled cluster contains one or more events across 10 fixed replay(s)
zero_event_pseudoreplication_audit.episode_estimand: event probability per independently sampled episode
zero_event_pseudoreplication_audit.scope: authored zero-event replication audit; repeated members do not establish episode independence, and changing repeat count also changes the cluster outcome

scope: fixed episode-table protocol audit; not simulator evaluation
